description: The Zenodo provider deposits a 2019 rooftop-photovoltaic monitoring workbook and factsheet based on a Vietnam Electricity report. The Zenodo page says the XLSX reports installation counts and total capacity by type and size for each listed province as of 31 December 2019. It gives national totals of 22,232 systems, 378 MWp installed and 99,288 MWh cumulative generation. The XLSX and a short PDF are public under CC BY 4.0. Provincial installed capacity could calibrate rooftop-PV adoption or distribution-grid hosting simulations for a historical baseline. The figures are a 2019 snapshot, not current capacity or a map of individual interconnection points. The description calls the coverage 64 provinces; the workbook was not opened to reconcile that count with administrative units or the sheet rows. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this EVN snapshot. The CSV-equivalent schema and provincial values remain unverified.
name: FACTSHEET ON ROOFTOP SOLAR DEVELOPMENT
